plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for DEVA Broadcast network service device. It reports uptime, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 35833).
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr8p8 Integer32 value is scaled by /256 in the query to degrees Celsius. Do not treat the raw SNMP value as °C. High values may indicate cooling or ambient-temperature risk.

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed in revolutions per minute from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Integer32 value is used as reported with no scaling. Persistently low or zero RPM can indicate a stalled fan or cooling failure.

metrics.name: deva_rf_level
metrics.description: RF input level in dBµV from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr8p8 Integer32 value is scaled by /256 in the query. Persistently low RF level can indicate antenna, feeder, or off-air signal problems.

metrics.name: deva_pilot_level
metrics.description: Optional 19 kHz pilot average level from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr8p8 Integer32 value is scaled by /256 in the query. Missing scalars yield no point.

metrics.name: deva_mpx_level
metrics.description: Optional MPX average level from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr8p8 Integer32 value is scaled by /256 in the query. Missing scalars yield no point.

metrics.name: deva_left_audio_level
metrics.description: Optional left-channel audio average level from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr8p8 Integer32 value is scaled by /256 in the query. Missing scalars yield no point.

metrics.name: deva_right_audio_level
metrics.description: Optional right-channel audio average level from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr8p8 Integer32 value is scaled by /256 in the query. Missing scalars yield no point.

metrics.name: deva_rds_ber
metrics.description: Optional RDS bit-error ratio from the PEN 35833.37 monitoring tree. The Fr1p15 Integer32 value is scaled by /32768 in the query. Missing scalars yield no point.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
